Name: MythicFenix's Firebirds for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from MythicFenix, I've updated their phoenixes (found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4846]here[/url]) to work with ContentPatcher for SDV 1.6. Yes, I'm aware of BrianOvaltine's Redux version, as I helped develop it. This is a much more basic, just barebones conversion of the original mod, and both MythicFenix and BrianOvaltine gave me their blessing to post my version. Credit to MythicFenix for the original mod.

Phoenixes live in coops and produce feathers and eggs that can be turned into mayonnaise.

Enjoy!
